Beta Updates

Surge Engine

• Added VLESS Encryption (mlkem768x25519plus), including share-link import and proxy editor controls.
• Added VLESS XHTTP transport with stream-one, stream-up and packet-up modes over HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2 or HTTP/3, including VLESS Encryption and Vision.
• Reduced memory retained after QUIC downloads on lossy networks.
• Improved QUIC upload performance and reduced CPU usage when chained through a proxy's UDP relay.
• Fixed established VLESS gRPC, HTTP/2 CONNECT and TrustTunnel connections being incorrectly counted as connection setup failures when they ended with an error.
• Fixed WebSocket policies failing to connect when their ALPN list included h2 and the server selected it.
• Fixed Tailscale connections staying on a relay after a peer restarted because updated peer information was not applied.

Surge iOS

• The proxy editor now imports share links for all supported proxy protocols, as well as proxy lines copied from Surge profiles; unsupported settings are reported instead of silently omitted.
• Reorganized the proxy editor with an Advanced page that indicates settings in use, and added controls for more protocol, TLS, WireGuard, Tailscale and testing settings.
• Fixed Always use CONNECT not being saved for HTTPS policies, and corrected when TLS and Block QUIC settings appear.
• Updated list layouts and badges, and added member counts for policy groups in the proxy list.

Surge Mac

• The proxy editor now imports share links for all supported proxy protocols, as well as proxy lines copied from Surge profiles; unsupported settings are reported instead of silently omitted.
• Reorganized the proxy editor with a remembered Show Advanced Settings option and controls for more protocol, TLS, WireGuard and Tailscale settings.
